messages.subject: Kestrel - subscription agreement drafting
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Elena,

Let's get the Subscription Agreement out to Birchall Stone tomorrow. Use the Granite/Helix precedent but note this is a minority investment, so the warranty package should be lighter and the cap should start at 100% of the subscription amount. Expect Birchall to push the cap and the claims period - hold the line at completion within 30 business days for now.

Elena, please make sure the cap table and funds flow tie to the £20m / £10.00 per share numbers.

Kind regards,
Sarah
Sarah Whitfield  |  Partner

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
